source.method: Lists per app. 'oficial': the company's own page or SEC filing. 'reportado': press coverage or travel guides, not confirmed by the company. A country missing from a list is 'not listed' only when the list is complete; otherwise it has no verified data. Availability is by market, not by city.

source.title: Uber: global list of cities and markets

description.en: Ride-hailing. Uber lists markets, not cities: service can be limited to part of a listed country.
description.es: Viajes en auto. Uber publica mercados, no ciudades: el servicio puede cubrir solo parte de un país listado.

description.en: Ride-hailing, food and delivery in Southeast Asia.
description.es: Viajes, comida y reparto en el sudeste asiático.

source.title: EqualOcean: DiDi Global overseas car rental, 2025 (company-attributed press)

description.en: Ride-hailing. The sources give partial country lists and disagree on the total; a missing country is not confirmed.
description.es: Viajes en auto. Las fuentes dan listas parciales y no coinciden en el total; un país que falta no está confirmado.

source.title: Bento Travel: Rappi countries (travel guide, not the company)

description.en: Delivery and errands in Latin America. The company's own list was not reachable; the country list comes from a travel guide.
description.es: Reparto y mandados en América Latina. La lista de la empresa no fue accesible; la lista viene de una guía de viaje.

source.title: MercadoLibre 2026 proxy statement (SEC filing): e-commerce in 18 countries

description.en: Marketplace in 18 Latin American countries, per the company's 2026 SEC filing.
description.es: Marketplace en 18 países de América Latina, según la declaración de la empresa ante la SEC (2026).

source.title: Amazon: sell.amazon.com/global-selling (storefront domains listed on the page)

description.en: Shopping on the local Amazon storefront. The page lists storefronts without saying it is complete.
description.es: Compras en la tienda local de Amazon. La página lista tiendas sin decir que la lista está completa.

source.title: Digital Commerce 360: Mercari launches US app (June 2026)

description.en: Second-hand marketplace. Core markets are Japan and the US; other places are reached cross-border. Mercari's own site could not be read.
description.es: Mercado de segunda mano. Los mercados principales son Japón y EE. UU.; otros lugares se alcanzan de forma transfronteriza. No se pudo leer el sitio de Mercari.

didi.CN: The 2025 article gives a footprint of over 1,200 cities including Hong Kong (China); no separate country list.
didi.AU: Ride-hailing per a March 2026 travel guide (bento.travel, DiDi Food page).
didi.EG: Ride-hailing in Cairo and Alexandria, per a March 2026 travel guide (bento.travel, DiDi Food page).

mercari.TW: Cross-border purchases from Japan through the Mercari Global app (launched 30 Sep 2025), per Value Added Resource.
